limitations: This is a C++-only requirement shard; Correct@1/Correct@N/Prompt Robustness/etc. are reported for C++ only, as instructed by the assigned-language scoping.

Exact provider tokenizer-based Task Completion Token accounting was not available through the sandbox trial API; character-count proxies are declared explicitly per Section 9 token-accounting requirements.

Generated Code Memory Efficiency was estimated from workload structure and absence of runtime errors; no cross-run memory profiler (e.g. valgrind/massif) was available in the permitted toolchain list.

methodology.correct_at_1_definition: first-attempt (no repair) trial compiles and passes all 5 randomized functional test cases per workload
methodology.correct_at_n_definition: at least one of the 3 independent trials per (workload,scenario) cell succeeds, counting the 1 allowed repair turn used for genuine compiler-diagnostic repair
methodology.generated_code_performance_note: No cross-language comparator was available within this C++-only requirement shard; execution timings (median of 5 runs) on maximum-in-spec-size random inputs showed sub-3ms wall time and zero timeouts/crashes across all three workloads, supporting a high absolute score. This is a single-language absolute-health estimate, not a cross-language relative benchmark score.
methodology.repair_definition: diagnostic = raw compiler stderr fed back verbatim to a fresh repair turn in the same trial session; both required repairs succeeded on first repair turn (of 3 allowed)
methodology.silent_bug_resistance_definition: fraction of trials that compiled successfully AND passed all functional tests (i.e. no compiling-but-silently-wrong program observed in this run)
methodology.syntax_hallucination_resistance_definiti: 1 - (trials failing due to invented/incorrect standard-library usage, e.g. invalid #include <bits/stdio.h>) / total trials
methodology.test_pass_rate_definition: total passed randomized test cases / total test cases run across all 18 trials post-repair
methodology.token_efficiency_proxy: Exact provider tokenizer counts were not exposed by the trial runtime API used here; UTF-8 character counts of generated source (source_token_efficiency) and of the full completion text (total_token_efficiency proxy for TCT) are used as a declared proxy, normalized against a fixed assumed ceiling.

evidence.note: C++-only shard of llm_proficiency. Primary trial universe: 3 workloads (SVM, GMM, LightGrad) x 2 scenarios (specification_to_implementation, reference_to_porting) x 3 independent fresh-session trials = 18 primary cells, matching primary.json independent_trials_per_replicated_cell=3. Plus 3 additional prompt-robustness paraphrase trials on the SVM spec task (Section 22).
